content: Implement a source-local Vulkan Tier 3 device-local copy adapter for W0132. Bind a host-visible staging buffer to a device-local buffer, submit bounded upload/download copies through the existing generation-bound timeline context, and verify a round trip without changing the stable backend C ABI.

Committed d050de2. Added source-local Vulkan device-local copy resources and generation-bound command submission. On AMD/RADV, a 4096-byte host pattern uploaded to and downloaded from the device-local buffer matched byte-for-byte; direct test reported queue-family=0 timeline=4. Full .#vulkan-runtime CTest passed 90/90.
